sections.title: Synopsis
sections.markdown: Strong hybrid DPS/support for Leva-centered Electric teams or comps with the blade-wielding crew. Very capable support in her base form; while her V2-V4 upgrades have attractive potency upgrades to her support capabilities, fortifications are mostly about turning her into a monster DPS at V6. Regardless, Sextans also happens to be a monster at Voltage tile creation, generating large areas of Voltage tiles twice per turn.

upgrades.description: S2: add Sanguine Emblem trigger, add Confectance Index gain (1), add Rigor Sanguis stacks gain (2)
Ultimate: increase AoE. All Amaranth Brand effects enhanced.

Passive: additional tile of movement and now grants Bypass (Phasing). Increased critical rate overflow cap for Rigor Sanguis to 45%. Increased damage for Sanguine Emblem. Enhanced increased damage taken effect for Carmine Emblem.
Ultimate: now applies Electric Boost II to all allied units.
S2: increased damage and healing and cleanses an additional debuff; no longer removes Blood Kiss.

Passive: start combat with 5 stacks of Rigor Sanguis and increases its stack cap to 15. Sanguine Emblem damage multiplier increased, ignores some defense, and no longer consumes Confectance Index (i.e., no trigger limit). Increases melee damage dealt by all allies when Sextans' Confectance Index is full.

sections.title: Team notes
sections.markdown: Grants increased Electric and Melee damage dealt, applies increased Melee damage taken, and grants increased stability damage dealt and stability index ignored - Sextans is an MVP for Leva-carry Electric teams. Additionally, her strong support for melee, blade-wielding Dolls enables blade comps in all types of content. Note that Sanguine Emblem needs allied units attacking with a blade specifically to be triggered.

sections.title: Build notes
sections.markdown: Healing is based on Sextans' attack. Build her like an Electric DPS. Her damage is 100% Electric- and Melee-typed: the Close Assault attachment set is recommended. Note that Sextans converts overflow critical hit rate into beneficial effects via the stacking Rigor Sanguis buff. Rigor Sanguis grants much more critical hit rate than the cap of overflow benefits. This doesn't really change BiS goals unless you want to try to drop critical hit rate attachment stats for health boosts for Ichor Conversion-maxing in her Remolding Pattern.
